Job details mentioned below
 Job Title:C# Developer
 Location: St. Louis, MO 
 Contract : 7 months contract to hire
 

 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 Development on multiple tiers and OS environments 
 Candidate will participate perform multiple enhancements and/or new functionality to applications. 
 Strong Analysis and Design skills 
 

 Basic Qualifications: 
 To be considered for this position, you must minimally meet the knowledge, skills, and abilities listed below: 
 Four year (Bachelor degree) and a minimum of 4 years of related work experience. Will also consider 8 years of work related experience in lieu of degree. 
 3+ years of experience using with C# 
 Experience with Microsoft .net environment 
 Experience with XML and XSLT 
 Experience with Windows event logging 
 Experience with Webservices 
 Experience with Object Oriented Programming Techniques 
 Must be a self-starter. 
 Must have strong analytical skills. 
 Must be able to clearly communicate (both verbally and written). 
   Desired Qualifications 
 Experience developing/supporting accounting systems would be helpful 
 Experience with Linux/Unix. 

 Bachelors Degree

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
